assistant.title: Assistant mode
assistant.hint: For the ballot desk. Hold a paper or phone QR ballot up to the camera. Each code is sent to the host, which checks it and records it as an unconfirmed ballot for the tab room.
assistant.noTournament: Open a tournament, or join a host as a device, to use assistant mode.
assistant.scanning: Scanning. Hold the code steady in front of the camera.
assistant.partial: Part {have} of {of} read. Show the next part of the same ballot.
assistant.cameraDenied: The camera is blocked. Allow camera access for SimpleTab in the system settings, then try again.
assistant.noCamera: No camera was found. Connect one, or enter the ballot by hand.
assistant.cameraFailed: The camera could not be started. Close other programs using it and try again.
assistant.videoLabel: Camera view for scanning QR ballots
assistant.scanAccepted: ballot for {room} received; the tab room confirms it.
